title: Fractions and Decimals of a Million
introduction: Explore fractions and decimals of a million using everyday examples.
definition: One million equals 1,000,000. A fraction of a million is that fraction multiplied by one million; a decimal million is the decimal multiplied by one million. Practise fractional denominators 2, 4, 5, 8 and 10 and decimals up to three places.

examples.question: Convert 2 3/4 million to a whole number.
